import html # Existing template string with placeholders for the post components. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{headline}

Posted by: {poster_name}

{text}
{tags}
""" def compose_post_html(poster_name: str, headline: str, text: str, hashtags: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster_name : str Name of the author. headline : str Title of the post. text : str Main content of the post. hashtags : list[str] List of tags to be displayed. Returns ------- str Safe HTML string ready for inclusion in a web page. """ # Escape all user‑supplied content to avoid injection safe_poster = html.escape(poster_name, quote=True) safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=False) # Wrap each tag in a element and escape the tag content escaped_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in hashtags ] tags_html = ' '.join(escaped_tags) # Format the final HTML using the template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster_name=safe_poster, headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text, tags=tags_html )
